plusSoft.reason: Intra-line inserted text in the diff editor; vague.nvim has only one opaque DiffText colour.

errorSoft.reason: Intra-line removed text in the diff editor.

warningSoft.reason: Debugger stack-frame highlight and warning overview markers.

searchSoft.reason: Non-current find matches, hover highlight and strong word highlight; vague.nvim only has the opaque search colour.

visualSoft.reason: Inactive selection, selection and word highlights, fold background; VS Code needs translucent variants to layer under text.

commentSoft.reason: Scrollbar and minimap slider resting state.

commentMid.reason: Scrollbar and minimap slider hover state.

commentStrong.reason: Scrollbar and minimap slider active (dragging) state.

shadow.reason: Widget and scrollbar shadow; vague.nvim defines no shadow (FloatShadow reuses visual).

searchHover.reason: Button hover background: search lightened by roughly 10%.
